en: The postcard features a historical black-and-white photograph of an ornate, late-19th-century building adjacent to a landscaped park with walking paths, trees, and flowerbeds. The building is architecturally grand with classical details, and the park area appears well-maintained. The front of the postcard includes the printed text 'Sundsvall. Vängåvan.' The reverse side contains handwritten Swedish text, postal instructions, and an address in Stockholm.
